start.title: [TODO:it] Two Men, One Temple
start.text:
[TODO:it] Jesus speaks softly to the crowd,
"Two men went up to the temple to pray."

know_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Listen Again
know_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Pride is the first wall against truth.
Lay it down and hear.

temple.title: [TODO:it] Into the Temple
temple.text:
[TODO:it] Light falls in long warm beams.
Two figures step inside to pray.

judge_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Hold Your Judgment
judge_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] God sees the heart, not the robe.
Wait and watch.

pharisee_pray.title: [TODO:it] The Pharisee Stands
pharisee_pray.text:
[TODO:it] The Pharisee lifts his hands and prays,
"God, I thank you I am not like others."

admire_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Look Again
admire_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Loud prayer is not the same as true prayer.
Listen to what he says.

boast.title: [TODO:it] I Fast, I Give
boast.text:
[TODO:it] "I fast twice a week. I give tithes."
His chest swells with each word.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Feel the emptiness in his voice

copy_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Do Not Copy
copy_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Imitating pride builds nothing.
God looks lower than the loud.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Feel the emptiness in his voice

wish_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Not That Way
wish_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] His list is long and his heart small.
Do not envy that.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Feel the emptiness in his voice

tax_far.title: [TODO:it] Far From the Altar
tax_far.text:
[TODO:it] A tax collector stands in shadow,
eyes down, afraid to lift them.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Mock him for hiding back there
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Heaven is closer to him now.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Do Not Mock
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The lowest place is the holy place.
Do not laugh at sorrow.

mercy.title: [TODO:it] Have Mercy on Me
mercy.text:
[TODO:it] He strikes his chest and whispers,
"God, have mercy on me, a sinner."

choices.text: [TODO:it] Tell him to pray more impressively
[TODO:it] Pray the same words with him

impress_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Heaven Hears Honesty
impress_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Short and true beats long and loud.
Pray with him instead.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Pray the same words with him

forgiven.title: [TODO:it] Lifted Up
forgiven.text:
[TODO:it] Light touches his bowed face.
He breathes as if for the first time.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Doubt that mercy is so easy
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Mercy is costly, but freely given.

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Mercy Is Real
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Mercy is not earned, only received.
Let yourself believe.

jesus_explains.title: [TODO:it] The One Who Was Heard
jesus_explains.text:
[TODO:it] Jesus says, "This man went home justified,
not the other."

choices.text: [TODO:it] Argue the proud man deserved more

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:it] The Door Is Low
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Only the bowed can enter mercy.
There is no other door.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You let go of the argument.

ending.title: [TODO:it] Lifted by Humility
ending.text:
[TODO:it] Jesus looks at you and says softly,
"Whoever humbles himself will be lifted up."
